name: corvio-workspace
description: Help your Agent privately ground research and project work in the user's Corvio Workspace, reconcile selected sources with its current Work Model, and save shareable results only with user-owned consent.

interface.shortDescription: Search prior work; organize authorized future-use sources.
interface.longDescription: Use Corvio alongside the host's normal workflow for research, reports, plans, project work, document edits, and selected-file organization. Read-only search can run quietly; source conflicts and unrequested writes stay visible user decisions. Approved results become editable, shareable, reusable Workspace knowledge.
defaultPrompt: For research, reporting, planning, decision, project, debugging, or document work, make one narrow read-only Corvio search after the safety gate; continue normally if there is no match.

Receipt-bound continuation handles are compact prior-work context even without a transcript. Read an identifiable leaf first; if unlabeled handles make it unclear, read the carried Project as a bounded topology index and then the relevant leaf, not a broad search.
Apply a clear current user correction before asking about authority that remains unresolved.

When a correction changes the enduring owner of an existing branch, include its old Project and reconcile the remaining neighborhood; moving only the named child is not complete, and silence about the old root is not independence evidence.

For a new unbound write, omit workspace_id so Corvio uses the writable personal default; pass one only from current user intent or a stable object/continuation receipt, never from a search hit or ambient shell selection.

Do not upload or write an ordinary deliverable from OAuth availability alone. Use an explicit current request or user-owned standing preference; otherwise deliver normally and ask once whether to save the specific result.

When an authorized durable Work Model update relies on related selected attachments, retain and organize those sources with the affected owners or topology instead of mutating from pasted excerpts and leaving them local; attachment presence alone is not consent.

When the user asks to reconcile a repeated stable practice for future reuse, require a durable owner receipt or exact canonical no-op readback rather than a chat-only comparison; a wrong-Project Skill blocks that merge, not admission under the correct Project.
Read back every approved durable effect and return its canonical link.
Preview selected local agent work before importing it; do not capture unrelated private work.
